name: cozysuite
description: cozysuite: Sean Cozart's Claude Code tools, one plugin per problem. Tools install per project.

plugins.name: cozysuite
plugins.description: /cozysuite:setup picks this project's tools: it reads the repo, recommends a preset plus or minus named tools, and installs them at project scope after you confirm.

plugins.name: core
plugins.description: Preset for any code repo under the workflow: ai-sdlc, ponytail, cozy-view, cozy-setup, cozy-cleanup.

plugins.name: site
plugins.description: Preset for a cozystudio client site: studio, cozyskills.

plugins.name: cozy-cleanup
plugins.description: /cozy-cleanup:cleanup frees disk space without losing work: proves what is on GitHub, backs up what git cannot hold, keeps ongoing projects, deletes only what you approve. Safe while other agents work.

plugins.name: ai-sdlc
plugins.description: Ties agent work to source control: intent, GitHub issues, ADRs, a proof gate, and agent orchestration of issues. Needs mattpocock-skills (installed with it).

plugins.name: ponytail
plugins.description: Third party (DietrichGebert/ponytail): forces the simplest, shortest solution that works. Pinned here so it updates only when this catalog moves.

plugins.name: cozy-setup
plugins.description: Sean Cozart's session setup: the Cozy Architect output style and the macOS PATH guard hook. Private repo.

plugins.name: cozy-view
plugins.description: Agent observability for Claude Code on Databricks: /trace how a skill behaves in real sessions, and transcript sync that stays off until the machine names a profile. Private repo.

plugins.name: cozyskills
plugins.description: Report and marketing skills: cozyreport (findings, metrics, changelogs as a published page), optimize-seo, optimize-aeo, skill-or-script. Private repo.

plugins.name: studio
plugins.description: cozystudio: client websites from intake to launch, checked the way a visitor sees them, and every later change as a preview and a forwardable report. Private repo.
